comment: The win-path balance values that a caller sets at run time, one row for each.
A tuner reads this file and needs no other knowledge of the engine.
kind is threshold when the value only decides when a reader fires, and rate
when a change to the value changes what the simulation does. A threshold is
scored by post-processing one recorded run. A rate needs a new run.
scale is fix32 for a raw Q16.16 value, and int for a whole number.
path names the win path the value governs, or null.
The domination path holds no row, because its reader compares no value.
The territory reader compares no value either: it fires at the tick limit and
takes the faction with the most held tiles, so the tick limit is its row.
Every default_raw is the value a world holds when nobody configures it.
Each min_raw and max_raw is a search bound and not a rule of the engine.

params.name: renown_target
params.doc: the renown at which the renown reader fires

params.name: renown_per_fell
params.doc: the renown one felled unit gives the champion of the faction that felled it

params.name: wonder_victory_claim
params.doc: the victory claim the wonder row carries; the wonder reader fires above zero, and zero takes the path out of the game

params.name: wonder_work
params.doc: the work that finishes a wonder

params.name: tick_limit
params.doc: the tick at which the territory reader fires and gives the game to the faction with the most held tiles
